evidence.title: Introducing the FFASR Leaderboard: Benchmarking ASR in the Real World

summary: A new leaderboard, FFASR, has been introduced to evaluate automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems under real-world conditions. The benchmark aims to provide more accurate and practical comparisons of ASR models.
title: FFASR Leaderboard Launched to Benchmark Real-World Automatic Speech Recognition Performance
